svg.title: MPx Squeeze v2 — cut open · assembled view
svg.desc: Illustrative cutaway of the assembled MPx Squeeze v2 on a bottle neck: water passes outside-in through the 20 µm prefilter cup, spreads under the roof ribs, passes down through the 1 µm disc, runs between the drain ribs to the stem and out of the push-pull spout. Built from the v2 drawing-set profiles; threads omitted.
